description.en: Plays a motion on an object given by three numbers instead of a name (e.g. 42, 2, 3; what each number stands for was not traced). mode: the scripts pass 0 for most character motions, 3 for camera and effect animations, sometimes 1 or 2 (the values were not traced further). frames: the transition length in frames (default 30; the scripts often pass 0 for an immediate change).

true once requested.
null if the object is not found or has no motion, the script system is not ready or fewer than 4 arguments are given.

examples.case: During a talk (real usage, from ev42052200.nut)
With mode and transition (real usage, from ev44040014.nut)
